analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The same tables on the bed. The three short lines are in. The rest of the leaf stays pale. He reads them and does not add a fourth.
On the tables. The stylus lies in the gutter of the tables. No sum. No hour. No title under the three lines.
On the tables. A thumb on the cover, not yet closed. The grey cloak is still on the peg by the door.
